rows.definition: Pure checked geometry for NVFP4 scale images: computes rows*scaleCols linearLen, pads rows to 128 and scale columns to 4, and returns the padded swizzledLen and tileCols.
rows.distinction: Describes lengths and tile geometry only; it is not SwizzleNVFP4Scales or UnswizzleNVFP4Scales value permutation, tensor element ordering, checkpoint weight packing, state/KV layout, scale-image allocation, execution, or hardware qualification.
